mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_blocks (blocker_id, blocked_id, reason, created_at) VALUES (#{blockerId}, #{blockedId}, #{reason}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (blocker_id, blocked_id) DO UPDATE SET reason = EXCLUDED.reason
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_blocks WHERE blocker_id = #{blockerId} AND blocked_id = #{blockedId}
mapper.select: SELECT blocker_id, blocked_id, reason, created_at FROM user_blocks WHERE blocker_id = #{blockerId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_blocks WHERE (blocker_id = #{first} AND blocked_id = #{second}) OR (blocker_id = #{second} AND blocked_id = #{first}) )
